title: Encoded proof recovers the linear function
statement: For every binary vector $w\in\ br^n$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$, the linear function extracted from its encoded homogeneous quadratic proof is the dot product with $w$: at every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, its value is $w\cdot x$.
